exam.title: Cisco Certified Support Technician Cybersecurity
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite. Build defensive asset-threat-vulnerability-risk-control reasoning; identity/access and cryptography; TCP/IP, infrastructure, segmentation, firewall, wireless and monitoring fundamentals; endpoint baseline/log/update/malware procedure; authorized vulnerability lifecycle and contextual prioritization; continuity/recovery; evidence-preserving incident triage, escalation, response and documentation.

review.notes: All five public work areas and all 23 first-party exam-aligned training objectives are mapped through assets/threats/risk/controls, identity/crypto, network defense, endpoint baseline/update/malware procedure, vulnerability lifecycle/continuity and evidence-preserving incident handling. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 36 checks are included. No stable public domain weights are invented. Eight links are reachable and O'Reilly is automation-blocked; none are broken.
